from: owner (chat, 5 screenshots), sent as a weak example
status: captured, judged by 2 combined AI jurors and the owner (2026-11-02)

business.what: Residential full-time tennis academy near Lake Como, part of the A-Rete club; ITF juniors 14-18 and ATP players 18+, 8 spots a season; apply, then a mandatory trial of at least a month (inference: parents pay, trial likely paid).
business.action_that_pays: Apply for your spot (first at about 31% of the page)

entries.veto: Accessibility: body text, eligibility criteria and the APPLY button label at about 2.1:1 (white on #8fc156, light green on white), 32 desktop and 26 mobile elements.

claims.claim: Logo too big, covers most of the navigation
claims.evidence: Measured: the logo badge is fixed, 280x183 px (about 20% of the screen height), so it rides over the page on every screen; it overlaps the header band and body text while scrolling rather than the menu links themselves. New inspector check fixed-cover.

claims.claim: Pictures stuck together yet leaving empty space; no spacing between sections
claims.evidence: Photo rows touch the dark band with 0 px while about 320 px stays empty at each side; sections are separated by colour bands and inconsistent gaps, not by a spacing rhythm.

claims.claim: Typography gets untidy and keeps getting smaller while scrolling
claims.evidence: Not steadily smaller: display sizes jump without a scale (65, 53, 35, 150, 115, 35, 30, 50, 30, 50, 35, 50, 150 px down the page); long ALL-CAPS paragraphs at 15 px and 100+ characters per line. New inspector check display-sizes.

claims.claim: Font inconsistency strains the eyes; size contrast is fine but needs consistency
claims.evidence: One family (DIN) in five cuts plus a serif italic (Arapey) in the footer; 16 font sizes; ten display sizes; the same heading role at 35, 50 and 53 px; no h1.

claims.claim: Colours, text and backgrounds mix so text is hard to read
claims.evidence: 32 text elements below WCAG AA on desktop, measured on screen pixels (white on lime green, light green on white, text over photos); the jury vetoed it.

library_candidates: A concrete capacity line ('8 spots available: 6 for 14-18, 2 for 18+ ATP') as honest scarcity
The apply button right after the acceptance criteria
Hero video of the academy's own players
avoid: A fixed logo or badge that is not a slim bar
Display sizes without a scale (more than 4-5 steps, one role each)
Long passages in ALL CAPS, body text under 16 px, lines over 95 characters
Text on mid-tone colour fields or photos below contrast
Pictures touching a band while floating with wide side gaps; no spacing rhythm
Giant background words cutting through headings
A first screen that serves the parent club's navigation instead of the page's offer

owner_taste_signal: First negative example (owner 4/4). AI weighted 4.3 against the owner's 4: the closest AI-human agreement so far, which suggests the owner's high scores elsewhere are taste for visual craft rather than leniency.
